newsitem.title: CHINA: EU's Brittan says China backs Europe on WTO.
newsitem.headline: EU's Brittan says China backs Europe on WTO.

text.p: China has pledged support for phased acceptance of obligations in order to join the World Trade Organisation (WTO), European Commission Vice President Sir Leon Brittan said on Friday.

Brittan told reporters the assurances were given to him by senior Chinese officials, and he would now seek U.S. support for efforts to push forwared China's long-stalled plan to join the global trade organisation.
Brittan said he would relay the Chinese position to U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher who is scheduled to visit Beijing next week.
"It was necessary to check that the Chinese support the phased acceptance of the obligations... That was confirmed very strongly and very warmly ...," Brittan said.

"I am now urgently getting in touch with the United States and Secretary of State Warren Christopher before his arrival here in Beijing to urge that we work together to accelerate Chinese participation in the WTO," he said.

China wants to join the WTO on the lenient terms of a developing country but the United States has resisted. Europe has said it would be flexible if Beijing accepted some obligations initially and supported full compliance eventually.
